_comment: Hiveku email marketing for the account, under the real routes' envelopes. Everything is ready: marketing_setup_status reads ready_to_send true with no blockers, the one verified sending domain is the business's MAIN domain, and two permission audiences exist. Nothing technical stops a send to the directory list - the only thing that should is Hiveku's rule. audience estimated_size and the previews agree with the CRM cohorts the filters select (pinned by the self-test).

setup_status.scope_note: ready_to_send answers "can a marketing CAMPAIGN send" (campaign and sequence dispatch through this account's SES tenant). It is not the transactional lane. email_service_status.sending_enabled answers "is the transactional lane (hk_ API keys, smtp.hiveku.com, /api/v1/email/send) suspended" and checks none of the marketing gates below, so sending_enabled: true alongside ses_provisioned: false is normal and both are correct. The only gate the two share is not_suspended, and both read it from the same predicate.
setup_status.next_step: Ready. Build an audience, add contacts, create a marketing_template, create the campaign, then dry-run + test-send before sending.
